description: Photographed on the museum's outdoor display and captioned as such in an Alamy stock image of the Laotian Army Museum; the Lao People's Liberation Army Air Force operated the MiG-21 from 1975. Variant NOT established and deliberately blank; no serial published anywhere I reached. This is the only aircraft at the site I am willing to assert

Captured Royal Lao Air Force / US-supplied Huey; the museum's displays are built around captured American materiel and the UH-1 is the one aircraft type named consistently across the accounts I read. Variant H assumed from the type's Lao service and flagged as such; serial unknown
aliases: UH1; UH-1H; Huey; Iroquois; Bell 205; UH1H
